scope: Read-only diagnosis of saved targets, fitted models and their actual loss; no retraining, no replacement target
gradient_primary: B-stage P rich_spectrum; October-December are actual fit rows, January-February are exposed development evaluation rows
staged_sample: deterministic evenly spaced rows, at most 24000 per head and split; final gradient distribution on all applicable rows
leaf_check: reconstruct first-tree leaf aggregates on all real training rows; compare shrunk Newton update -lr*sum(g)/(sum(h)+l2) with saved values
uniform_weights: Every known side-attempt has weight one for fill; only known filled side-attempts train path; no day, duration, overlap or class weighting
temporal_masks: same date and side, exact regular grid; conservative completed-minute quote validity and segment certificate on both 30s and dense 1s diagnostics; unknown breaks; every conditional interior origin must also be filled, EMPTY breaks the conditional run
dense_dates: first nonempty source day of each source month, fixed before measurements
scene_selection: the five dense calendar dates; full supported session and fixed London+60min to +120min zooms for October, January and February; no selection by PnL or target roughness
local_rate_visual: centered 20-minute realized frequency for audit only; uses hindsight, is not a training target, causal input or true conditional probability
permutation_control: shuffle observed labels within date/side while retaining unknown and conditional-fill masks; a descriptive dependence reference, not a volatility-preserving economic null
limitations: Hard outcomes can be jagged even when conditional probabilities are learnable; smooth predictions can be an uninformative prior. Loss gradients on B are diagnostic residuals, not training updates. No economic admission from smoothness.
